title: Finchain on its own: usable with no application in the picture
source: chain/out/evm-acceptance.json (operator key on host A's workstation through the public RPC), manifests/evidence/evm-acceptance-verify-37854.json (host B's own node at finalized), a MetaMask transaction read back through the public RPC, chain/out/erc8004.json; values read from the chain
boundary: Nothing here belongs to a covenant or to an agent runtime: an ordinary key, cast, a browser wallet, the public endpoint. docs/world.md section 2, docs/acceptance.md M3-A.

evmAcceptance.mode: the three transactions were sent by scripts/evm-acceptance.sh on 2026-11-12; the record was written from their receipts (mode from-receipts) after the first run failed on a formatting defect of the read-back check (cast's large-number suffix), fixed in 0.2.0-alpha.4; nothing was sent twice

fees.note: near-zero base fee on a quiet chain; the L1 data fee is read from the receipt field l1Fee

verificationOnHostB.rpc: http://100.120.188.50:8545 (host B's own op-reth, not the public endpoint)
verificationOnHostB.method: receipts by hash (status, block, block hash), code keccak at the checked block, storage slot 0, eth_call and the recipient balance at the completing block 37183, completing block canonical and at or below the finalized head

walletTransfer.what: an ordinary wallet user sends ETH by hand through the public RPC: MetaMask with the network added manually (RPC https://rpc.finchain.one, chain id 85422)
walletTransfer.type: 0x2 (EIP-1559), nonce 1, gas 21000, effective gas price 1000251 wei, l1Fee 226 wei

identityRoot.role: application-level registry anyone on the chain may use; needed by no node and no wallet

result: M3-A passed on public-testnet: all five items of docs/acceptance.md M3-A demonstrated
openItems: the probe contract has no access control by design; its state is checked at the completing block, never at the head
